name: world_map_dirty
note: The traveller's world map, a hand scroll on washi: an island chain with a snow volcano, forests, compass rose, rune labels and the dotted route by foot, ferry and rail to where the tea grows. idle: the stave end curls up and settles; turn: a full 3D turn (front, edge, back with the title slip and notes); unroll: the cord slips off and it unrolls left to right; route: the route draws itself. State: dirty.
